turns.verbatimText: Morning Bill, good news, we think you're ready to go home today.
Home today? That's quicker than I thought.
You came in with what turned out to be a heart attack, we've treated that, and your heart's looking stable now on the scans.
We're starting you on aspirin, one 75 milligram tablet once a day, that's to help stop clots forming — you'll take that every day going forward, indefinitely.
Just the one tablet a day?
We're also starting a new one, lisinopril, 10 milligrams once a day, that's for your blood pressure, also ongoing.
